parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the instance resides.

parameters.name: TargetVersion
parameters.description:
The major version to be upgraded to. Valid values:

*   **0.10.2**
*   **2.2.0**

If you set this parameter to the current major version, the system upgrades the instance to the latest minor version.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka upgrade-instance-version --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000 --target-version 0.10.2 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
